summary: Innventure, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01. Item 7.01 discloses an upcoming operating company CEO conference call and attaches a presentation. Item 8.01 reports that the Board adopted stock ownership guidelines for directors and executive officers, aligning leadership interests with stockholders. There are no financial terms, premiums, or M&A activity. This is a routine disclosure of corporate governance and investor relations, not a special situation.
